clips.prompt: Cinematic hand-drawn 2D anime psychological horror and forensic detective drama. Delicate consistent linework, handsome adult faces, realistic restrained acting, desaturated teal shadows and a small amber practical light. Not live action or 3D. The reference fixes ONLY character faces and clothes: Jian Ci, pale adult male with black tousled hair, white coat over black turtleneck, black examination gloves; Lin Qian, adult female detective with short black bob, navy police jacket. No extra cast or costume changes. Location is ONLY the shared stairwell of an old modern residential building: chipped cream wall above green dado, gray concrete stairs ascend screen-right toward one CLOSED rusty teal iron door on the third-floor landing, single caged warm bulb above it, dim window light from screen-left. No bedroom, office, desk, or furniture. One coherent building, no teleportation, no reverse walking. Stable eyelines, keep Jian Ci screen-left and Lin Qian screen-right whenever together. Dark but clearly readable faces and evidence. Compose important action between 20% and 82% frame height, leaving safe areas for later captions. No writing, subtitles, logos, or generated text. Exactly THREE motivated shots with hard cuts at the specified times; no dissolves or random montage. Let attention and action continue across cuts. Mandarin only, only the quoted dialogue, never add speech. Lin's voice is steady adult female low-mid register, Jian Ci quiet measured adult male baritone, Gu Qing a frightened but intelligible adult female whisper. Natural speech with breathing room. Clear dialogue above sparse room tone; restrained dread, no musical stingers, no screaming, no gore, no apparent attacker, no random ghost. NIGHT BEFORE THE DEATH. No police. Gu Qing is unseen except beige sleeve and hand. SHOT A 0-2 seconds: fixed low angle wide of empty stairs and closed upper iron door, a heavy footstep from beyond the door at 0.8; much empty darkness above the frame, no one visible. SHOT B 2-5 seconds: hand holding recording smartphone, tiny red recording dot, no legible screen text, closed door blurred in background. Gu Qing whispers across shots from 0.9 to 4.3 exactly: “楼上又有脚步声。” SHOT C 5-10 seconds: tighter static view of the SAME CLOSED upper door, hand lowers OUT of frame naturally; an irregular metal scrape and a little falling dust, no door opening. Gu Qing whispers 5.3-8.6 exactly: “可他们说，那一层早就封了。” Leave last second quiet with the empty door. Dread from an unseen source, not monsters.

subtitles.speaker: 顾晴（录音）
subtitles.zh: 可他们说，那一层早就封了。
subtitles.en: But they said that floor was sealed off.

subtitles.speaker: 林浅
subtitles.zh: 检刺，死者顾晴，这里的社工。
subtitles.en: Jian Ci, this is Gu Qing, the social worker.

subtitles.speaker: 林浅
subtitles.zh: 报案人说，她失足摔下来了。
subtitles.en: The caller says she slipped and fell.

subtitles.speaker: 检刺
subtitles.zh: 先别定性。伤要和现场对得上。
subtitles.en: No conclusions yet. Match the injuries to the scene.

subtitles.speaker: 林浅
subtitles.en: Okay. I'll find out who last saw her.

subtitles.speaker: 林浅
subtitles.zh: 同事转来的录音。原手机还在找。
subtitles.en: A colleague forwarded this. Her phone is still missing.

subtitles.speaker: 林浅
subtitles.en: It's stopped. There are still footsteps upstairs.

subtitles.speaker: 林浅
subtitles.zh: 增援守住出口。我们在三楼门外。
subtitles.en: Backup, cover the exits. We're outside the third-floor door.

subtitles.speaker: 检刺
subtitles.en: Stay back. The sound is right behind that door.
